locations.note: Lara tracks the Fiamma Nera to an abandoned opera house in Venice and stows away on Bartoli's seaplane.
A monk of the Barkhang Monastery helps Lara through the Tibetan foothills toward the Dagger's resting place.
The game opens at the Great Wall, where the chamber of the Dagger of Xian is sealed.
The training level, and the last level: the Fiamma Nera storm Lara's home after the Dagger.

routes.name: Lara Croft
routes.note: Lara chases the Dagger of Xian from the Great Wall to Venice and a Tibetan monastery, back to the Great Wall to face Bartoli, and home to an attack on Croft Manor.
